author: M. Devries
text: Still waiting on the metrology engineer for leg three. No engineering owner yet, which is now the bottleneck.

author: A. Roth
text:
DOE on the cell B reticle stage completed for the first two legs. Overlay X-drift tracks reticle dwell time almost linearly above 40 seconds, consistent with reticle heating rather than a stage calibration fault.

Ruled out: stage calibration drift, chuck flatness, and the reticle swap itself.

Next: leg three with the compensation model enabled, on DRY 0.7 first. Blocking issue: no engineering owner assigned.

author: M. Devries
text: Leg one done. Drift grows with reticle dwell time above 40 s.

author: M. Devries
text: DOE plan agreed: dwell time as main factor, field position as blocking factor. Slot on cell B booked.

author: A. Roth
text: Containment closed. Cell B held for DRY 0.7, 100% overlay metrology in place on affected lots, rework path signed off with production.

author: M. Devries
text: Cell B released for DRY 1.0 again; DRY 0.7 stays on hold until the cause is known.

author: M. Devries
text:
Bucketed the first 8 Z3s on overlay out of spec. Common signature: X-drift at field 14, Litho B only.

Problem closed.

author: J. Meijer
text: Second supplier can deliver in three weeks. Committed availability needs to move; will raise at DRB.

author: J. Meijer
text: Expedite refused; looking at a second supplier. Solution close will slip past the committed date.

author: J. Meijer
text: Supplier quoted six weeks for the new nozzle type. Asked for an expedite.

author: J. Meijer
text: No change since the last update; solution work continues as planned.

author: J. Meijer
text: Waiting on data; solution plan unchanged.

author: J. Meijer
text:
Swap test on 12 lots: new nozzle, no particles. Cause confirmed.

Cause closed.

author: J. Meijer
text: Nozzle inspection on clean tool 1 shows wear on the edge-bead nozzle.

author: J. Meijer
text: Waiting on data; cause plan unchanged.

author: J. Meijer
text:
WET 0.8 rerouted to clean tool 2; capacity impact acceptable for four weeks.

Containment closed.

author: J. Meijer
text:
Nine Z3s bucketed; all outer ring, all after Clean. Problem statement drafted.

Problem closed.

author: A. Roth
text: Two lots released after re-measurement. Last held lot waits for the SEM slot.

author: A. Roth
text:
CD loss confirmed on five lots, all recipe v4.2. Problem statement agreed with process integration.

Problem closed.

author: S. Oyelaran
text: First week of data: 43 Hz peak that matches the chiller compressor. Facilities asked for damping mounts.

author: S. Oyelaran
text: Accelerometers installed on the stage frame and the chiller base.

author: S. Oyelaran
text:
Critical layers moved to cell A; cell B only runs non-critical layers during chiller start-up.

Containment closed.

author: S. Oyelaran
text:
Six vibration alarms, all day shift. Amplitude 5–7 nm peak against a 3 nm spec.

Problem closed.

author: K. Baars
text: Pulled the chamber logs for both events. Both spikes happen right after a chamber clean, so this looks structural. Proposing to accept at the next DRB.

author: S. Oyelaran
text:
Compared the two signatures with M. Devries. Offset direction and location differ from Z5-118, so we keep this separate for now.

Next: overlay maps of the next three WET 1.0 lots to confirm.

author: P. Sandu
text: Week two of four: still clean. Next exchange planned for week 43 will be the real test.

author: P. Sandu
text: Week one of four: no edge defects after the last exchange.

author: P. Sandu
text:
Procedure rolled out; 14 technicians trained. First exchange with the new procedure done.

Implement closed.

author: P. Sandu
text:
Deburring step and tighter torque spec written into the exchange procedure.

Solution closed.

text: Started as provisional so we can work on it while SAP creates the Z5. Backside inspection added for the next five lots on clean tool 1.
